reviews.text: I took my six-year-old cat who had never been bathed and detested me trying to comb her. They are finished in two hours and a half. They told me three I was told she only swatted once she got A lion cut.
I brought my two anxious cockapoos for a grooming today and I'm happy with the care and cut they received.  Thank you.
I have 2 very sensitive to grooming rescue dogs. Juju and her incredible team are always calm, gentle and conscientious. My pups always come out happy, calm and beautifully coiffed.
My Berry receives amazing service and care every single time she visits. All the staff are amazing. Thank you
The best groomers in Toronto! They care so much for their little clientele, and it shows! 🐾❤️
Seriously they are the best groomers in Downtown-Toronto

My Lucy has been going to JuJu’s since she was 17 weeks and is now 5.5 yrs old. She loves going in and comes out happy and with a little swagger. The team is always so understanding and patient with me and Lucy. They also were attentive when she was going through her skin allergies and would adhere to the dermatologist’s instructions and also provide some tips and guidance to me. Lucy always gets complements on her hair cuts in our neighbourhood and we always refer people to Juju's.

I have been taking my two gorgeous Westies to Juju Grooms for years now, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with them. They are senior dogs and tend to get stressed easily, so finding someone who is not only amazing at grooming but also genuinely caring and gentle with them means so much to me.

Juju always gets their groom perfect. At this point, I don’t even have to explain what I want because she knows them so well and always knows exactly how to make them look their best. But what I appreciate most is how gentle and patient she is with them. She takes the time to make them feel comfortable and shows them so much care when I drop them off.

It gives me such peace of mind knowing they are in good hands, especially as they get older. They always come home looking absolutely adorable, happy, and beautifully groomed. I’m so grateful we found Juju and couldn’t recommend her more.

Gracie is not an easy dog to groom, but Juju always listens to our concerns and takes the time Gracie needs. Given everything Gracie has been through over the past few months, we were especially concerned about keeping this visit as stress-free as possible. Juju worked with us and decided that shaving her down was the best option to reduce both the grooming time and Gracie’s stress. We really appreciate Juju’s patience, understanding and genuine care for Gracie.

Juju & team always treat Tilly, my dog, with care and love, and in return she has grown to love her time being groomed (by Juju, never by me). My cat, George, needs a lot of haircuts, and, LOVES this team. They return home smelling clean, and looking adorable. I’m so happy I found Juju & her staff. Would not go anywhere else.
We love Juju Grooms! Our dog always comes back happy and super cute :) thank you for taking such good care of her!
Jo was Super friendly and my dog looks amazing thank you so much!

Patrick has been going to Juju Grooms for years, and I genuinely can’t recommend them -  especially Kate - enough.

Patrick is a poodle, so unfortunately for him, grooming is a pretty regular part of his life 😂 He’s also a very nervous and reactive dog and can be quite particular about the people he trusts. Kate has always been incredibly patient and kind with him, and somehow they always have nothing but wonderful things to say about how good he was and what a little angel he is -  which, as his owner, I know is not necessarily the experience everyone gets!

Whatever they’re doing at Juju to make grooming feel safe and comfortable for him clearly works. He absolutely loves Kate, which means so much to us because he really doesn’t trust that many people. He always comes home looking beautiful, happy, and completely unbothered by the experience.

Having a groomer you trust is important with any dog, but with a nervous/reactive dog who needs frequent grooming, it’s honestly invaluable. We’re so grateful we found Kate and Juju Grooms. ❤️
I love they service and care about the pets 🩷🩷🩷🩷

Wow Jo at JuJu Grooms was exceptional! It was our puppy’s first groom and he looks amazing and had the best time. She was also such a pleasure and took in what we were looking for and delivered an exceptionally perfectly groomed and happy puppy back to us!

We’ve been going here for quite a while, and I couldn’t be happier with the care they give my cat! Everyone is so friendly, kind, and gentle with her. They handle her with so much love and patience, which means a lot to me.

She always comes home looking absolutely beautiful, clean, fresh, and smelling wonderful. You can really tell that they genuinely care about the animals they work with. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a groomer they can trust! ❤️🐾
Juju is the best, she’s been Bo’s groomer since 2017 and Betty’s groomer since she was a puppy 2020!!
Best groomer in Toronto period! Thanks Juju for taking care of Louya since 2019

The dog grooming is amazing, the only place my baby goes and leaves happy without stress.
Now I tried the cleaning teeth services and one more time I'm not disappointed. I really appreciate the job and I recommend the services.

Brought my new little nervous ch-iggy mix in for a nail trim today and had a 1000/10 experience. I tried trimming at home, but the scream he screamt woke the ancestors and I decided we need professional intervention as I’m apparently even more of a chicken than him. Walked in to super positive vibes, met with kindness and a spotless shop. They did such a great job! Got all his nails done quickly and as soon as we left he had a new spring in his step and he’s been zooming around happily since. I could tell his nails were bothering him so I’m so grateful to the wonderful groomer (I’m so sorry I didn’t catch her name) who was so gentle cleaning up his feisty talons! So grateful to have them in the neighbourhood. We’ll be coming for regular pawdicures. Thank you endlessly Juju Grooms!
I asked for teddy bear cut but my dog got a very bad haircut instead
I am so happy with my dogs grooming results. He looks fabulous

I am so so happy I went to juju. I have been looking for a Groomer since I got my little Pom Nine months ago. He looks absolutely beautiful and he is not easy. He does not like to be groomed so I have to say Lili was incredibly patient and definitely knows what she is doing!  Thank you!!!

We’ve been bringing our dog to Juju Grooms for almost three years now, and we wouldn’t trust anyone else in the city. Jenny is an incredible groomer—our pup always leaves looking amazing, and it’s clear how much she genuinely cares about every dog and their experience.

She takes the time to make sure each groom is done with care and that your pet leaves looking exactly how you’d hoped. You can tell this isn’t just a job to her; she truly loves what she does.

I would 100% recommend Juju Grooms to anyone looking for a skilled, caring, and trustworthy groomer in the city!
I was struggling to trim my cattle dog’s nails, so I brought him to Juju and they got the job done in 5 minutes. Friendly, professional, and affordable. Thank you!

Rosie the Rescue Dog and I love JuJu Grooms ! Rosie is a little rescue dog and can be nervous but it’s clear how much the staff love their furry clients and they make every special effort to make her feel comfortable. She emerges from her summer cut like a new dog , and is so happy to be so cool and stylish . Just a wonderful place . Can’t recommend it highly enough!

Had a quick walk in visit to discuss my dogs needs and they were so kind and welcoming. They got my senior dogs nails trimmed and cleaned up so well and we will be going back to get a full groom. So friendly and did an amazing job. Highly recommend!!

EDIT: just tried to look into a groom from them and they BLOCKED MY ACCOUNT lol.

——————-

I’ve been a client for over three years and have always had great experiences—until today.

We came in for a simple nail trim with a new groomer and my dog was badly injured. A 3-minute trim turned into 10 minutes, during which I heard my dog screaming the entire time. He was returned with a bloody dew claw and an exposed quick, followed by a brief, sheepish “sorry.”

Once home, I discovered that 8 nails had been cut into the quick, both dew claws were severely injured, and clotting powder had been applied throughout. My dog cried the entire way home.

We had to contact our vet for pain medication, order bandages, cancel his bath, and now must closely monitor him and keep a cone on to prevent infection—especially stressful during the holidays when vet hours are limited.

To make matters worse, I was initially charged for the nail trim of my injured dog, with the fee only removed after I pointed it out. There was no apology or acknowledgement of the harm done.

What should have been a routine visit resulted in injury, added expenses, and significant stress.

Juju Grooms is great. My senior dog goes there to have a bath and haircut-he always comes out so handsome. Katie is very patient and gentle with him and does a superb job each and every time. A happy customer!
I would not trust my furbaby to anyone else!

Lilly did the most amazing job again with my boy Rupert.   He is a difficult boy ! And somehow she is able to create this!!!
Just beautiful!
Juju’s is a great place to groom your cat. They are very careful and thorough. My little guy loves his lion cut!
I always know that our “spirited” cat is in good hands and will not  only leave looking beautiful, but she will also be well-loved during her experience!
Juju does a beautiful grooming job for my Pom. He gets really anxious, and this is the only groomer he doesn’t panic at.
Treated my little guys so well. Great communication! Thank you Kate and Juju!!! It’s so nice to have a groomer in the west end!
Thank you for the wonderful experience for her cosmetic dental cleaning and great for regular grooming thank you so much
Really appreciate the care and attention the team pays to my anxious pup. He looks so happy after an appointment when he’s fresh and clean.

We’ve been taking our Golden Retriever Stella to Juju for years, and we couldn’t be happier. Stella is very anxious and sensitive, but Juju and the grooming team know exactly how to care for her with such a gentle, patient approach. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing she’s in such good hands. Highly recommend!

We have been bringing our dog to Juju’s for a few years now. We’ve always had a great experience. Our dog comes out looking gorgeous! We would happily recommend anyone to go there. Friendly service from start to finish
Amazing work as usual, love Oreos haircut

Best groomer ever! Have booked with various groomers at Juju and only ever had great experiences. Easy to book, talented staff, super friendly desk staff, nice store, and most importantly, very good to your pet.

My 15 year old dog looks like a puppy every time! We have even tried taking him elsewhere (closer to home) and always end up returning to Juju regardless. 10/10 recommend!

Milo had his second groom with Kate and we couldn’t be happier! 🐶✨ She is such a lovely, calm person with such good energy 💕 She really takes her time to make sure Milo feels comfortable and stress-free, and the cut was excellent ✂️🐾 She listens carefully to exactly what we want and always does an amazing job. Milo looks adorable every time 😍 Highly recommend Kate! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I have been taking my Mini Dachshund to Juju Grooms for 7 years.
Recently I attempted to reschedule my appointment the day of the appointment. I called first thing in the morning as soon as the business opened. Britany the receptionist was not accommodating nor understanding and was rude and condescending.
While it is true they have a $100  cancellation fee, as a long time and loyal customer I asked that this fee be waived or at the very least applied to my next appointment. Canceling the day of my appointment is not something I have done before.
As per their website policy which states the groomer has the discretion to waive the fee; I was not permitted to speak to her. Nor was I permitted to speak with the owner Juju.
The reason for my cancellation is up for debate and they do indeed explicitly state their cancellation policies.
I just find it appalling they would rather take $100 than accommodate a long time customer. Most small businesses would not operate in this manner and value and respect their loyal clients.
Sahar - thank you for your service but I will not be bringing Hector back to Juju Grooms. This is not a small business I would like to continue to support.
Does a perfect grooming on my Luna long hair cat. Stress free for Luna

We have had nothing but fantastic service from Juju. Our groomers have been the sweetest kind of humans whose treatment and  care of our non human family while they go through a stressful but necessary time (for our dogs anyway) has been nothing short of exceptional! Thank you Ayumi and previously Sahar.

I have a very anxious goldendoodle - she is always really good at the groomers however, with an anxious dog - as a pet owner you always worry leaving them in the hands of someone else. Juju was exceptional with my girl. They took the time to discuss with me prior to the appointment, and also got to know Miloh 1 on 1.

I am so grateful that I can take my dog to a place where she looks fresh and comes out feeling better. Thank you so much Juju.
My touchy, sensitive corgi came out looking handsome. Thank you so much Joanne for taking care of him. We couldn't be happier. See you guys next time.

We have been seeing Kate since we got Bobby and me and my partner were looking for someone who would give him the best care. And Kate is amazing.

I made a review before and I will stand by what I said.

Everyone at JuJu Grooms is super friendly and Kate always does such an amazing job.

We love JUJU! They’re the best.

Our dog is 16 years old and they always give him extra care to cater to his age.

Highly recommend! We also have a new puppy and the team couldn’t be more caring.

Fanatic groomers
We love Juju Grooms!
Juju Grooms has the best people they are always such sweeties with our pups! We so appreciate the extra care taken with our anxious boy.. they are the only reason his nails can be trimmed.
I have always been looked after exceptionally well and Rosie the golden retriever real customer loves everyone and I think it’s a great service
Mani, Pedi, and a blowout. Bugsy is looking and feeling great after his spaw session today. Thank you Juju Grooms staff for taking care of my fur baby!
Excellent service as always! My pup never seems stressed after his groom, which has not been the case with previous grooming salons. I’m so relieved we found Juju!

My Pomeranian was shaved shorter than intended by Wendy at the previous Dundas location, and unfortunately he has experienced ongoing coat and skin issues since then (fur loss, post-cut alopecia, infection). I didn’t initially leave a review, as I understand mistakes can happen, but since this hasn’t resolved, I wanted to share our experience so other pet owners with double-coated breeds can make an informed decision. Attached photos of him before, right after and currently.

Love this place! My dog always comes home looking and feeling great. Lovely welcoming staff, warm and skilled groomers, and overall wonderful atmosphere. Super easy to get an appointment time that worked for me. Highly recommend.

Becky and Juju are wonderful people who give extra special attention and care to my very large, very anxious giant breed.

They deserve 10 stars.
Juju is amazing! Thor can be a bit spicy, but at JuJu he’s very happy. Can’t say enough great things about these great folks.
Tafi was relaxed and very happy after his groom with Jo today❤️. He’s old, nervous, losing hearing and sight and unfortunately an anxious dog at times but he loves juju grooms!
Juju never disappoints, an  amazing experience every time. I, highly recommend taking your fur babies here
Great service, lots of care to the animals and fantastic service delivery! Highly recommend

Kate is truly the best. After trying several groomers, I finally found the one I can fully trust. The gentle care they give Lona makes all the difference. Even when I bring her in quite matted, she always comes back looking amazing — with her skin healthy and never irritated or nicked. Kate even gave us a little bottle of spray to help untangle her hair for us to take home☺️

I’ve been bringing Silly here since her very first groom and have recommended Juju to many friends because I truly trusted their care. That’s why this experience was especially disappointing.

Immediately after picking her up and placing her in her bed in the car, I noticed blood. When I checked her paw right away, it was actively bleeding. This was not mentioned at pickup. I’ve attached photos for reference.

In addition, the haircut itself was very uneven compared to her previous visits. The fur under her chin looks patchy and uneven, which has never happened before .

I understand that grooming matted fur can be more challenging and that accidents can happen. However, if a nail was trimmed too close to the quick or any injury occurred, I believe it should have been clearly communicated at the time.

I reached out directly to express my concerns. While I received a response suggesting possible causes, there was no clear explanation or accountability. I followed up again for clarification and did not receive a reply.

What ultimately made me decide not to return was the lack of transparency and communication in how this situation was handled. After years of trust and recommendations, this was very disappointing.

Best spot in Toronto! Juju handles my difficult-loveable dog with ease. It gives me such peace of mind that my dog is no longer stressed about getting groomed (and comes out looking so fantastic). Thanks to the team - you are the very best!

I have had Chows for over 4 decades and they have gone to groomers. Unfortunately they have a bad reputation but as always it’s not the dog or the breed it’s the owner . My Chows are kind and quiet and don’t have an aggressive bone in their body.when is started interviewing groomers , many were scared or told me they will use muzzled and harsh tactics. No matter how much I explained that Chows are NOT aggressive, it was to no avail. Juju was the only one that respected what I said, understood and trusted us and so we also trust her. And she loves them and it shows.
I have taken both of my chows since they were puppies to Juju and I must say she is the best there is . Not only she is knowledgeable and kind as a human being,  but as a groomer she is exceptionally patient and excellent at what she does. Once thing Chow do have in common is they’re stubborn. The only way they will obey you is if they like you and respect you and if you give them time to digest and do it in their own terms , they melt in your arms .one of my Chows,  Yoshi is aging and has acute arthritis in all his joints, despite injections and medication he has a hard time standing for long periods. Juju sometimes has to lay on the floor to do Yoshi’s groom!!!. And she takes her time and does an amazing job every time. Which is every 8 weeks. I have tremendous respect and I am in awe how kind she is . Yoshi and Moosh are my world and I wouldn’t trust them to anyone but Juju. Her entire team are professional, alert you if they see anything that needs to be addressed. Ask questions, get to know your fur baby and do an outstanding job. I cannot recommend enough. Love love love .

We took Rocco to Juju Grooms for his first haircut. Jenny was so kind and patient with him, and she did an amazing job! She took wonderful care of him and we will absolutely bring our little guy back.

Ayumi always does the best job grooming my dog ginger. I can’t thank you guys enough for always taking care of her in the way I would take care of her myself. I always feel safe and secure knowing ginger is in the best hands and she always looks amazing!
The team at Juju is amazing and I’m so happy I discovered them. They take such great care of my cat and give her a terrific haircut and nail trimming. Thanks so much!
Ivy was amazing! Our Shihtzu not only walked out looking gorgeous but they also were so calm and had zero anxiety leaving Juju unlike other groomers where they left with high anxiety. TY! ❤️🐶 …

I was looking for a really great cat grooming place for a long time and had some genuinely horrible experiences at other places before finding Juju Grooms. From the moment I started bringing my cats directly to Juju herself, I knew we had finally found the one.

She is hands down the best groomer we’ve ever had and the only person we fully trust with our cats. The cuts are always unbelievable, clean, beautiful, and done with so much care. Our cats are comfortable, we feel at ease, and we’ve honestly never once been disappointed.

If you’re looking for someone who truly understands and cares for cats, Juju is unmatched. We wouldn’t go anywhere else.

Juju grooms is a 5 star place to bring your pets for an amazing grooming experience. Their  kindness, friendliness, and hospitality make such a difference,  not just for us, but especially for our cats. The level of care and patience they show is exceptional, and it’s clear how experienced Juju and her staff are.

Their grooming skills are outstanding, the customer service is always top-tier, and most importantly, our cats feel completely at ease here. It means everything to us that our cats are comfortable, calm, and actually love their groomers. We’re beyond happy and satisfied with the work they do every visit and are so grateful to have found a place we fully trust. Highly recommend to any cat parent looking for truly exceptional care.

I recently had a super disappointing experience at Juju where one of my dogs was injured during a groom. The incident was not disclosed to me at pickup so I didn’t notice right away. But immediately upon getting home I realized I’d been given back an entirely different dog: stiff, unable to do stairs, shake off, nest, sniff the ground, eat, or move normally, due to an injury to his spine.

The indecent resulted in significant stress, sleepless nights tending to my beloved dog shrieking in pain, and medical expenses.

On top of the upset from the injury itself, I received shockingly poor treatment from Juju staff who lacked empathy, professionalism, and took zero responsibility for what happened while my guy was in their care.

It took days for them to respond to my phone call to inquire about how the groom went or any insights, and then days again for them to follow up with me.

A refund was never offered for my trouble, even though my experience resulted in medical expenses. When I suggested they cover medical fees, Juju asked for the chiropractor to call them, which, as the chiropractor confirmed, is an unprofessional request. I was happy to provide receipts for costs incurred but Juju refused to cover them.

Overall a devastating experience, and short sighted customer care on their part. Handled differently, I might have continued to bring them my two dogs for several grooms a year.  But as it stands, all trust and respect is lost, and my dog is still not the same as before.

In good faith, I cannot recommend this business. There are many other groomers out there who would have handled the situation with integrity, taken responsibility for their actions, and valued my loyalty and dog’s safety above all.
I started going to Juju grooms and seeing Kate a few years ago and refuse to go anywhere else. She does such amazing job with my dog and he looks so incredibly cute after, no more bad haircuts!!

Juju Grooms is a wonderful groomer! Juju has been caring, helpful, super gentle and expert at acclimating our new puppy to the grooming experience. She is patient and careful.  I highly recommend Juju Grooms for all dogs, but especially new puppies and older dogs who need a special, sensitive touch.
Kate at Juju Grooms is the best! My dog went from being super scared of going to previous groomers to just loving going to Juju. I definitely recommend this place, and specially Kate!
Really like the experience at Juju Grooms. Super friendly, great calm vibe and the best cuts. They didn’t hesitate to pick up my slightly anxious Cavapoo and carry her in for her groom today. 😍 …

I have been taking my dog to Juju for over 6 years. Booking process has always been smooth and easy, and you can’t go wrong with any of the groomers. Im always very happy with her cut and groom and she comes back looking and smelling fab! As a rescue dog, my pup is skiddish and very sensitive to loud noises. Everyone from front desk staff to groomer is kind and accommodating of her needs both physical and emotional needs. They make the grooming experience as positive as can be.

Always the perfect groom for our Yorkie, Spike! We completely trust Juju to make him look like a rockstar every time!
The staff and Papichulo are also a delight. Thanks Juju for a wonderful experience every time. ♥️
Incredible groomers! Lili does immaculate work and is amazing with our anxious little guy.
Friendly, professional, talented groomers! I am happy to have found a groomer for my dog that is close and does a great job.

From a grooming standpoint they do a phenomenal job. From a customer service standpoint they are also phenomenal, and I must say that when my dog figures out where we are she jumps out of the car and runs to the Juju door as hard and fast as she can. When the Juju around the corner from me closed I followed them to another location because I always felt comfortable bringing my dog to them (and still do!). Staff member redacted for privacy reasons but photo attached of my dog being pumped to be there.
amazing service, staff are super wonderful and my dog genuinely loves to get groomed here!
We wouldn’t trust our girl with anybody else. When other groomers wouldn’t take her because she came with a reactive history, Juju welcomed her like part of the family. Best groomers in Toronto.

Juju grooms was very communicative when it came to grooming cats! It being our first time owning a cat we were pretty anxious as she was a rescue who had been matted from lack of brushing at the shelter. Juju was able to effectively calm and ensure that Maya was in good care. We originally booked for a teddy cut but understood each cat’s temperament varies.

Juju was diligent in letting us know that Maya was not comfortable with the cut and instead removed the Matts while keeping her fur trimmed and ridding her undercoat. She wasn’t shaved and bald like most grooming places that shave their cats so we were incredibly happy with the turn out aesthetically as well as ensuring Maya’s well being.
Juju grooms is one of best groomers I’ve been to.  Kate is amazing with my sensitive dog, she is patient and experienced.  The staff are friendly and accommodating.

I have been taking my dog here for 2 years, I would not dream of taking him anywhere else. Kate takes really good care of him and his haircut is perfect every time. He’s always been an anxious boy, but I know he’s safe here! I think their pricing is reasonable too.  Thanks Juju, Kate and team!
My dog is quite an anxious girl and the staff at Juju Grooms are so great with her. She comes out happy  and looking fresh!

I’ve always been a little nervous about taking my dog to a new groomer because of past experiences, but everything changed when we met Ayumi over a year ago. She is incredibly patient and caring with my dog, which gives me complete peace of mind knowing he’s safe and well looked after. His grooming always turns out exactly how I hope, and we love going home with the cutest knitted collars Ayumi makes. She truly is an amazing groomer, and I can’t recommend her enough ❤️ 🐾
The great staff at Juju Grooms always do a great job with our dog Dizzy...!

Juju Grooms always takes such good care of my kitties! They come back smelling and feeling great, and I know they've been well taken care of. All of the groomers are so friendly and helpful too. I definitely recommend!
Juju Grooms and Kate do an amazing job with our dog. He always looks amazing! The best pet groomers in Toronto.

Our two dogs have been going to Juju grooms for over two years now and there is nowhere else I would take them. Not only do our dogs come out looking gorgeous, they always leave feeling happy and confident after their grooms. The care and attention given at Juju grooms is unmatched and I trust that they will always do right by our dogs for a stress free groom.
Juju provides a consistent great service, thank to Ivy, who is an amazing groomer that can manage very well big breeds with curly hair!

Juju grooms goes above and beyond with the care and time they put into a groom. Not a hair is misplaced on my dog after his groom today with Juju and he even got this adorable Christmas knit necklace which was the cherry on top. He’s going to be rocking it all Christmas season. Thank you!
A little pricey but worth it, especially if you have a nervous dog! They always do a great job and my pup is happy
I've brought my Maine Coon in for a couple grooms now and she always comes home beautiful and soft! Her fur mats easily but the products they use keep her coat so lovely.
We love Juju Grooms, they always take such care with our dog. She resisted other groomers, but goes in and comes out happy at Juju’s.

Juju has been doing an amazing job grooming my cat Mia! We’re in the Beaches and have tried other groomers, but no one compares to Juju. It’s definitely worth the trip to the other side of the city. We love the service!!!

Love Juju Grooms in Parkdale. Friendly and professional staff. My last dog TJ loved them. Our new dog, Marisol is nervous but they are always so good with her and she loves the cod skin reward.  Our cat, Pippa,  is old but they care of her when she goes for a groom. Thanks team!
Amazing staff. Ivy makes our dog Charlie feel comfortable. He’s very difficult to groom but Ivy manages to do an excellent job.

My family and I absolutely adore Kate from Juju Grooms. She’s incredibly sweet and patient with my anxious goldendoodle, Lilly.  Her grooms are absolute perfection, a work of art!  Cannot recommend this place enough 🥰 …
JuJu Grooms is the best! Sahar is so kind to our wee critter and thorough in grooming!

It’s always a pleasure to go somewhere you feel welcome and your fur baby is gonna be safe and treated with care and given attention you can trust is the best possible. Knowing they specialize makes every visit awesome and pleasure

I cannot begin to even express HOW AMAZING Jujugrooms is. They are a 10/5 star grooming company in Toronto. They take old dogs and cats, they are a fear free place and treat ALL animals with a level of respect and gentleness I have never encountered in my LIFE. They continually teach me new things and show me the inner world of pets and how to cherish them. This place is not just a groomer... this place changes your pets life. Don’t go anywhere else. Go here. You’ll thank me later <33 all the best.

Juju has been grooming my two cats for almost two years now. I have a Siberian cat with an extremely thick coat, and the team always does an incredible job combing it out and making it more manageable. My other cats is also long haired, but a lot more skittish, and he still does so well in Juju’s care.  I’ve taken my cats to other groomers too, and none of them have ever offered anywhere close to the quality or genuine care that Juju does!! Do not hesitate.
I've followed Ivy all over the city! Trust her completely and my dog loves her. We always get compliments on how well groomed and soft my dog is. Thank you!
Very easy to book. They are lovely people and my cat coco always seems calm and fine after a groomer which hasn’t been the case at other places. Highly recommend.

We have been bringing our little guy Henry here (and Shop Juju) for a number of years! Everyone is always so kind and Kate is incredibly talented! We sincerely appreciate her patience with our nervous boy. We are so glad to have found Juju Grooms and Kate!

We love Juju Grooms and have been brining our 1 year old Havanese Milo there since he was a puppy! Our groomer Jenny is amazing and so great with him. He always looks so handsome after a groom! Jenny goes out of her way to take her time and make sure Milo has a positive experience. Worth every penny!!
Recently started bringing my corgi here to get groomed. The staff are very friendly and take care of him so well! He’s always come out looking his best. Highly recommend!!
The Juju team are always the best! They welcome you with a smile every time, and treat my anxious dog with ultimate care.
We’ve been taking our dog Peanut for years, and he loves it! Today he came out of the salon with a complimentary Christmas hand knit collar that is so adorable!

We've been going to Juju's since their opening. Our pups always come back looking fresh and tidy. Most times when we call we're able to get in same day or within a day or two. And I love the festive additions!

My 7-year-old Goldendoodle Archie has been fabulously groomed at Juju Grooms Parkdale for several years now. I have an Australian Shepherd who is extremely fearful of blow dryers, vacuums, and any loud machinery, so I was searching for a groomer that specializes in working with anxious dogs. I came across Juju Groomers and was drawn in by their mission statement and glowing testimonials. When filling out the online appointment request, I clearly explained Nala’s trauma with the hair dryer and requested that she be towel dried only.

On the day of the appointment, we met our groomer. The very first thing I reiterated was Nala’s fear of the hair dryer and my request to avoid it completely. I also suggested that if possible, her haircut be done first, followed by the bath, and that we were perfectly fine taking her home towel dried. The groomer acknowledged my request and took Nala in.

Mid-appointment, I received a call from the receptionist, whose opening words were: “So… you were right, your dog is afraid of the hair dryer.” My heart sank. How is someone reaffirming something I have known for 5 years??? This confirmed that despite my repeated and clear instructions, Nala was still exposed to the very thing I had worked to protect her from. Not only was this deeply frustrating, but it was heartbreaking to know her fear and trauma had been unnecessarily triggered. I left feeling unheard, disregarded, and disappointed by the lack of care and attention to detail. To pay $250 for this service and not be listened to is incredibly disheartening.

While the grooming itself was beautiful and she smelled wonderful, the lack of accountability, communication, and adherence to my instructions overshadowed the end result. A groomer’s role is not only to make a dog look good, but also to ensure they feel safe and respected throughout the process. Unfortunately, that trust was broken.

I will not be returning and would strongly urge other pet owners—especially those with anxious dogs—to advocate firmly for their pets and ensure that their fears and needs are respected. Negligence in this area can have lasting impacts on a dog’s wellbeing.
